snippet.title: 2v2 Is Here | Valleyball Versus v0.4.0
snippet.description:
2v2 is here. Valleyball Versus v0.4.0 brings team matches to the physics sport where every limb is live and the ball never goes out. Build your team in the new lobby, bring your friends for 4-player split screen, or fill the other seats with smarter bots that pass, defend and go for the hoop.

Play free: https://ValleyballVS.com
Inaugural Championship: December 27, 2026

NEW IN v0.4.0
- 2v2 team matches, alongside 1v1
- A team lobby: home and away kits, ten team colors, headwear and three builds for every athlete, and a player or a bot (Easy, Medium or Hard) in any seat
- 4-player split screen with a camera for each player, and 2-player split screen with bots in the other seats
- Smarter bots: teammates split the work (one goes for the ball, one covers), pass and set each other up, slide, block and dive to defend, and judge range and angle on shots at the hoop
- Team and individual stats at the final whistle
- Every controller and keyboard steers its own player in the lobby, and you can plug a controller in at any time

Every athlete in this video is one of the game's own bots, and nothing is scripted. The matches ran in the real physics engine, then were replayed with film cameras. The 51.7 m/s volley is shown once in slow motion. Everything else is real time.
